youtube.title: Why Your Voice Sounds Weird On Recordings 🎙️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
You've never actually heard your own voice. When you speak, sound reaches your ears through the air and through your skull. Bone carries the low notes best, so you sound deeper in your own head. A recording only catches the air, and that's the voice everyone else hears.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy
